answer: Correlation-Priced Action Curve: each agent action draws saffron credits; price is base × (1+αc)^β, where c is a min-hash correlation over shared funding addresses, counterparties, and timing. Independent counterparties decay c inside a sable haven, keeping honest fees near base. A sybil cluster cannot hide correlation cheaply: N linked agents face exponentially rising marginal fees, or must acquire genuinely diverse funding/behavior sources, making each additional pseudonym costlier than the last. No gate; all may transact.
